note: Where each sound effect came from. All are from Fish Audio: either a ready-made clip in its sound library, or a sound made with its sound effect generator from the prompt shown. `trim` is the length in seconds the game keeps.

hatch.title: Magic 1
hatch.note: The swell in the middle of the same clip that `whoosh` takes its opening from.

jump.prompt: A playful cartoon jump sound that starts immediately: one quick rising springy boing, bright and friendly, like a platform video game character hopping, no voice
jump.note: Second try. The first was mostly hiss.

dash.prompt: A single quick airy whoosh of someone dashing past very fast, light and bright, cartoon video game, no voice

fire.prompt: A single small friendly magic fireball being thrown, a soft warm fwoosh, gentle cartoon video game, no voice

ice.prompt: Ice crystals freezing quickly with a bright glassy sparkle and a crisp crackle, a short magical frost sound for a gentle cartoon video game, no voice
ice.note: Second try. The first came back silent.

call.prompt: A single clear cheerful two-note whistle calling friends to come over, no other sound

web.prompt: A single soft sticky stretchy squelch, like stepping into a springy spider web, silly and gentle cartoon sound, no voice

chirp.prompt: One cute happy chirp from a tiny baby dragon, high and sweet like a little bird crossed with a kitten, short, no background

chirps.prompt: Four cute baby dragons chirping happily together, a joyful chorus of high sweet chirps and squeaks, no background

roar.prompt: A big grand dragon roar heard from far away, deep and grumpy but not frightening, for a children's storybook game

hurt.prompt: A single soft cartoon bonk, a gentle padded bump with a tiny comic wobble, harmless and funny, no voice

dizzy.prompt: A short cartoon dizzy sound, twinkling stars spinning around a head with a wobbly descending slide whistle, funny and gentle, no voice

failed.note: Sounds asked of the generator that came back silent and were not used. Each still cost 5,000 credits.
